北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京晴好，体感微凉 4℃，注意添衣保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny but feels chilly at 4℃. Remember to dress warmly!
北京.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天，体感 14℃ 挺舒服，记得带伞以防万一。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy, a pleasant 14℃. Keep an umbrella handy, just in case.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天，体感 13℃ 微凉，穿暖和点，别着凉啦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy, feeling a bit cool at 13℃. Dress warmly to avoid catching a cold!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州晴朗，体感 23℃ 挺暖和，享受阳光好天气吧！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny and feels warm at 23℃. Enjoy the beautiful sunshine!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳晴朗，体感 19℃ 很舒适，出门享受好时光吧！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny and a comfortable 19℃. Head out and enjoy the good weather!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天，体感 12℃ 凉意十足，出门记得加件外套。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy, feeling quite cool at 12℃. Remember an extra layer when you go out.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京晴朗，体感 12℃ 略有凉意，别忘了适时添衣。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is sunny, feeling a bit cool at 12℃. Don't forget to add layers as needed.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 13℃ 偏凉，注意防风保暖哦！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, feeling cooler at 13℃. Remember to protect yourself from the wind and stay warm!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉有雾，能见度低，体感 9℃ 湿冷，注意出行安全。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan has fog, low visibility, and feels damp and cold at 9℃. Please travel safely.
武汉.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗，体感 9℃ 干燥微凉，多喝水润润喉。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny, feeling dry and cool at 9℃. Remember to drink more water.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆晴好，体感 14℃ 舒适，出门散散步很不错哦！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is sunny and feels comfortable at 14℃. A stroll outside would be lovely!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨阴天，体感 -9℃ 冻手冻脚，全副武装出门哦！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is cloudy and feels freezing at -9℃. Bundle up completely before heading out!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴朗，体感 1℃ 凉意浓，多穿点别感冒了。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny but feels chilly at 1℃. Dress warmly to avoid catching a cold.
沈阳.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴朗，体感 11℃ 风力大，注意防风和补水。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny and feels windy and cool at 11℃. Remember wind protection and hydration.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门晴朗，体感 14℃ 略潮湿，记得保持衣物干爽。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is sunny, feeling a bit humid at 14℃. Remember to keep your clothes dry.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛有霾，体感 6℃ 偏凉，出行注意防护，保重身体。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao has haze and feels cool at 6℃. Take precautions when going out, and take care.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连有雾，体感 -3℃ 湿冷，出行小心，注意保暖防滑。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian has fog, feels damp and freezing at -3℃. Be careful when traveling, stay warm, and watch for slippery surfaces.
